description: This file implements storage management functions for observability webhooks and dead letter queue handling within the control plane of a larger system. It provides functions to get, set, delete webhook configurations, and manage dead letter queue entries including adding, listing, deleting, and clearing entries.

methods.name: GetObservabilityWebhook
methods.description: Retrieves the global observability webhook configuration from the database, returning nil if no configuration exists.

methods.name: SetObservabilityWebhook
methods.description: Stores or updates the global observability webhook configuration in the database, using an upsert pattern.

methods.name: DeleteObservabilityWebhook
methods.description: Deletes the global observability webhook configuration from the database.

methods.name: AddToDeadLetterQueue
methods.description: Adds a failed event to the dead letter queue table with associated error message and retry count.

methods.name: GetDeadLetterQueueCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of entries in the dead letter queue.

methods.name: GetDeadLetterQueue
methods.description: Retrieves entries from the dead letter queue with pagination support.

methods.name: DeleteFromDeadLetterQueue
methods.description: Removes specific entries from the dead letter queue based on provided IDs.

methods.name: ClearDeadLetterQueue
methods.description: Clears all entries from the dead letter queue.
